0022600171.text: The Clippers (1-4, 13th in the West) are looking to snap a four-game losing streak as they host the Raptors (3-2, 5th in the East), who have won three of their last five. Los Angeles is without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Toronto is missing Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Clippers won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 119-94 in Los Angeles on March 25, 2026.
